meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 当你请求修复 LazyCodex 或 Codex CLI 的 bug 时，Claude 会在临时工作区复现问题、编写测试、实施最小修复，然后针对上游 Codex 提交拉取请求，或针对 LazyCodex 提交包含补丁的验证修复问题。
howto.when: 当你提到“修复 bug”、“贡献 bug 修复”或“调试并提交 PR”等涉及 LazyCodex 或 Codex 缺陷的请求时触发。

say.text: 请帮我修复 LazyCodex 中的一个 bug。
say.note: Claude 会开始调查并提交修复 issue。

say.text: 为 Codex CLI 的一个 bug 创建一个 PR。
say.note: Claude 会 fork 仓库并创建 PR。

say.text: 为 code-yeongyu/lazycodex 提交一个验证修复。
say.note: Claude 会创建包含补丁的 issue。

howto.what_en: When you ask to fix a bug in LazyCodex or Codex CLI, Claude reproduces the issue in a temp workspace, writes a test, implements the smallest fix, then submits either a PR (for upstream Codex) or a verified-fix issue with a patch (for LazyCodex).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'fix a bug', 'contribute a bug fix', or 'debug and PR' for a LazyCodex or Codex defect.

say_en.text: Please help me fix a bug in LazyCodex.
say_en.note: Claude will investigate and submit a fix issue.

say_en.text: Create a PR for a Codex CLI bug.
say_en.note: Claude will fork the repo and create a PR.

say_en.text: Submit a verified fix for code-yeongyu/lazycodex.
say_en.note: Claude will create an issue with the patch.
